Looking at the system reminders and git status:

## The Project
**NCLEX-PN (Canadian RPN) Remediation CLI** — reads your missed-question tags from `seed/missed.json` (topic, client need, why you missed it) and generates a 7-day study plan. Standard library only, no database, everything stays in JSON so you can edit it on your phone.

## Rules That Apply
1. **No paid qbank content** — never include actual question text from UWorld, Archer, Kaplan, even paraphrased. Topic tags and your own notes only. Non-negotiable.
2. **PN scope of practice only** — everything must be reinforce/monitor/report/follow care plan. No RN-scope actions like "independently assess and initiate treatment."
3. **One motivation counter, no gamification** — you get "days studied in a row" on the summary line. No streaks, badges, leaderboards. (Earlier suggestion to add those — rejected and stays parked.)
4. **Local only** — no packaging, no GitHub, no network. Just for you.
